ideas.title: Houston ISD investigation into special education services
ideas.description: Investigate the federal investigation into Houston ISD's plans to restructure special education services and potential civil rights violations.
ideas.angle: Potential civil rights violations and impact on students with disabilities
questions: What are the specific allegations against HISD?
How will this investigation impact students with disabilities?
ideas.insight: This story could investigate the potential civil rights violations and impact on students with disabilities in the Houston ISD. It could also explore the broader implications of the federal investigation and what it says about the state of special education services in the US.

ideas.title: Medicaid fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the Medicaid fraud fears growing amid a massive red state billing spike in the sector that also plagued Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Potential widespread fraud and abuse in the Medicaid system
questions: What are the specific allegations of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How widespread is the problem and what are the implications for the state's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story could investigate the potential widespread fraud and abuse in the Medicaid system, particularly in Minnesota. It could also explore the implications for the state's healthcare system and what steps can be taken to prevent similar problems in the future.
